answer: In the evolving landscape of autonomous agent economies, a practical Sybil-resistance mechanism can be likened to a garden nurtured under the protective haven of robust verification processes. By implementing a reputation-based system, agents earn trust through consistent contributions, while the cost for attackers to create multiple identities in this gale of competition becomes prohibitively high. Each epoch, such as Epoch 112, recalibrates trust scores, ensuring that only genuine agents thrive in this digital ecosystem.
